experiments.name: uniform-options
experiments.reason: Uniform scope restores primitive inlining; 4096-frame matched full ISR improves.

experiments.name: uniform-unswitch
experiments.reason: Remove conflicting scopes; default loop unswitching improves WT and Bass.

experiments.name: wt-direct-envelope
experiments.reason: Removing table-pair cache regresses WT mean/max.

experiments.name: res-ordered-clamp
experiments.reason: Ordered clamping improves Snare target mean/max.

experiments.name: wt-direct-frequency
experiments.reason: Exact EMAC conversion is cheaper than cache-key testing on target.

experiments.name: res-fixed-decay
experiments.reason: Fixed-point recurrence reuse improves Snare mean/max; countdown crossing remains original path.

experiments.name: wt-unused-envelope
experiments.reason: Extracted helper is outlined; WT mean increases to 10299 cycles.

experiments.name: wt-unused-envelope-inline
experiments.reason: Forcing inlining restores throughput but mean/max still regress versus selected path.

experiments.name: bass-fixed-pitch
experiments.reason: Bass mean increases despite a smaller maximum; no sustained overall win.

experiments.name: wt-frequency-lut
experiments.reason: 16 KiB table increases WT mean and maximum versus EMAC.

experiments.name: wt-frequency-exact32
experiments.reason: Exact 32-bit algebra passes stream but extra sign/shift/multiply work regresses target throughput.

readiness_repair.scope: Repeated pre-RTOS initializer; no physical first-boot hang attribution.

implementation_plateau.assessment: Measured practical plateau after the recorded target experiments; integration qualification remains pending.
